property.name: language
property.label: UI language
property.description: 'en' (default) or 'fr'. Controls every visible string (toolbar, grid headers, status filters, modal).

property.name: erpCheckboxLabel
property.label: (deprecated) ERP checkbox label
property.description: No longer rendered - kept to avoid breaking existing page layouts.

property.name: salesChannelId
property.label: Default SalesChannel Id (optional)
property.description: 18-char Id of a SalesChannel record. Set on Order.SalesChannelId when an order is created. Leave empty to skip.

property.name: productImageFieldApiName
property.label: Product image field API name
property.description: Field on Product2 holding an image URL. Schema-safe: skipped if absent.

property.name: productImageFallbackUrl
property.label: Product image fallback URL
property.description: Used when no image is found on Product2 or ProductMedia.

property.name: aiReasonsCsv
property.label: AI recommendation tooltips (override)
property.description: Optional. CSV of '<rowStatus>|<message>' entries. rowStatus: recent | old | promo | clearance | oos. Each row picks deterministically from the matching messages. Leave empty for the bilingual built-in pool that follows the language property.
